loss: mean of four per-example assistant/EOS token cross-entropies; equal example weight
selection: minimum equal-task mean dev NLL among step0 and completed 512-step checkpoints; frozen dev, no test selection
primary_hypothesis: Matched instruction serialization plus short-answer supervised external QA mixed with broader Alpaca improves held-out label-ranking accuracy over EXT step256 without increasing held-out Alpaca NLL. Format validity alone does not establish knowledge improvement.
test_policy: Never train/select on old ARC128; new OpenBookQA official test, held-out PIQA official-dev subset, ARC-Challenge official test and new Alpaca holdout.
checkpoint_retention: step64, best dev, last two; hash receipts retained for pruned redundant recoveries
